Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays on chembl_id = CHEMBL1794523. Join activities on assay_id. Join molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno. Filter standard_relation = '=' and standard_value IS NOT NULL. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
